faq.q: Can I show up for a walk-in party?
faq.a: This location cannot accommodate walk-in or unscheduled birthday parties/events.

faq.q: What ages are good for a birthday party?
faq.a: Our Birthday Party Events are wonderful for children of most ages, but at times can be challenging for children under 5 years, as some younger children lack the physical ability to play the game of Mini Golf as well as the concentration to play a full 18 holes course.

faq.q: How can I reserve a birthday party?
faq.a: Visit the store, call the store directly, or book online from the location webpage. A deposit will be required to hold your preferred day and time; deposits vary by location and package.

faq.q: Do you offer a party specialist?
faq.a: We do! Just let us know you're looking for a specialist to help plan the day for you, and we'll be happy to help.

faq.q: Can you host a birthday party for adults?
faq.a: Absolutely! Parties are suitable for all ages, including adults.

faq.q: How long is a mini golf game?
faq.a: Your party can most likely plan on a round taking about 30-45 minutes, but the game really is what you make it.

faq.q: Are reservations required for mini golf?
faq.a: Walk-in guests are welcome for mini golf and other activities. Walk-ins may have to wait when it's very busy, so we recommend reserving your tee time ahead.
